## Memo derived metadata from content

Derived metadata is computed server-side by parsing markdown (goldmark + custom `#tag` / `@mention` extensions). Persisted fields live in `MemoPayload` (`memo.payload` JSON column); some values are recomputed on read instead of stored.

---

### 1. Computation sites (exact paths)

| Site | Role |
|------|------|
| [`internal/markdown/markdown.go`](internal/markdown/markdown.go) | Core AST walk: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `GenerateSnippet` |
| [`internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`](internal/markdown/parser/tag.go) | `#tag` token parsing rules |
| [`internal/markdown/parser/mention.go`](internal/markdown/parser/mention.go) | `@mention` token parsing rules |
| [`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`](server/runner/memopayload/runner.go) | `RebuildMemoPayload` — calls `ExtractAll`, writes `memo.Payload.Tags` + `memo.Payload.Property` |
| [`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go) | Invokes `RebuildMemoPayload` on create / content update |
| [`server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go`](server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go) | Calls `ExtractAll` for mention notifications (not persisted) |
| [`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go) | `getMemoContentSnippet` → `GenerateSnippet` (on-the-fly, not stored) |
| [`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go) | Reads stored payload; computes `Snippet` at API conversion time |
| [`proto/store/memo.proto`](proto/store/memo.proto) | Schema for persisted derived fields |

**Primary extraction logic** (`ExtractAll`):

```355:421:internal/markdown/markdown.go
func (s *service) ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error) {
	// ...
	// Tags from TagNode (skip inside links/images), deduped
	// Mentions from MentionNode, lowercased, deduped
	// Property.Title from first block-level H1
	// Property.HasLink / HasCode / HasTaskList / HasIncompleteTasks from AST node kinds
}
```

**Persistence hook**:

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	// ...
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

Markdown service is initialized with tag + mention extensions in [`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`](server/router/api/v1/v1.go) (`WithTagExtension()`, `WithMentionExtension()`).

---

### 2. Operations that trigger recomputation

**Persisted payload (`Tags`, `Property`)**

| Trigger | File / condition |
|---------|------------------|
| **CreateMemo** | [`memo_service.go:108`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go) — always before `Store.CreateMemo` |
| **UpdateMemo** | [`memo_service.go:436–451`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go) — only when `update_mask` includes `"content"` |
| **CreateMemoComment** | Indirectly via `CreateMemo` in [`memo_service_comments.go:56`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go) |
| **Batch rebuild (utility)** | [`memopayload/runner.go:RunOnce`](server/runner/memopayload/runner.go) — walks all memos in batches of 100; **not wired into server startup** (only referenced from API paths above) |

**Does not recompute content-derived payload**

- `UpdateMemo` with `"location"` only — sets `payload.Location` from request, no re-parse ([`memo_service.go:481–484`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go))
- Visibility, pinned, state, timestamps, attachments, relations changes

**On-the-fly (not written to `payload`)**

| Trigger | What is recomputed |
|---------|-------------------|
| Any memo → API conversion | `Snippet` via `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` ([`memo_service_converter.go:76`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go)) |
| Create/update with new mentions | `@username` list via `ExtractAll` for inbox notifications ([`memo_mention_helpers.go:32`](server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go)) |
| RSS rendering | `RenderHTML` ([`server/router/rss/rss.go:339`](server/router/rss/rss.go)) |

---

### 3. Extracted properties

**Stored in `MemoPayload` (from content)**

| Field | Source rule |
|-------|-------------|
| `tags[]` | `#tag` nodes; skipped inside links/images; deduped, case preserved |

| `location` | User/API input on create/update, not parsed from markdown |
